project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite SPA, mobile-first marketplace UI
build_system: Vite 5 with React plugin, supports AR/EN i18n with RTL, tailwindcss, vite preview
test_framework: None configured in Phase 1; verification via manual testing with `npm run dev`
test_command: None; use manual inspection and dev server
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run typecheck` to confirm no TS errors. 2. Run `npm run dev` to launch dev server. 3. Visit http://localhost:5173 (or assigned port) to visually verify screens, RTL switching, form interactions, and error states. 4. Test on both AR and EN. 5. Verify localStorage persistence for drafts. 6. Test offline mode by toggling network in DevTools.
environment_constraints: AR/EN locale switching must preserve all component state, RTL layouts must mirror LTR, localStorage key prefix must be 'marbou-', no third-party auth backends in Phase 2 (mock only), form validation uses basic HTML5 + custom checks, i18n strings live in src/i18n/translations.ts
contribution_requirements: 1. All UI must use MARBOU design tokens from tailwind.config.js (primary=green, secondary=orange). 2. All pages must support AR/EN via i18n context. 3. Components must be accessible (semantic HTML, ARIA labels on icons/buttons, focus states). 4. Mobile-first responsive design (base=mobile, sm/md/lg breakpoints). 5. Form state persisted to localStorage for drafts. 6. Mock data in src/data/mockData.ts, no real APIs. 7. Lazy-load pages via React.lazy in App.tsx. 8. Error states and empty states on all list/search pages.
key_patterns: 1. Pages lazy-loaded with Suspense fallbacks in App.tsx. 2. Context hooks: useI18n (for t, lang, formatPrice, etc.), useAuth, useApp (favorites, compare, myListings, showToast, etc.). 3. Form components controlled via state, export as named exports. 4. UI components (Modal, EmptyState, RatingStars, StatusBadge, etc.) in src/components/ui.tsx. 5. Category-driven EAV specs in getFields() pattern. 6. Mock data indexed by id strings (lst-001, usr-001, etc.). 7. RTL handled by lang==='ar' ternary on flex direction, text-align, icons, etc.; Tailwind rtl: prefix used sparingly. 8. Breadcrumbs/navigation use router Link and navigate(). 9. Loading states use Skeleton component; error states via EmptyState with icon + title + description + optional action button.
relevant_files: src/App.tsx (router setup, lazy page loads, role-based rendering)
src/pages/ (all page stubs: AuthPages, ListingDetailPage, AddListingPage, AccountPage, JobsServicesBusiness, FavoritesCompareMessages, SellerProfilePage, HelpPage, BusinessDashboard, AdminDashboard)
src/components/ui.tsx (shared UI: Modal, EmptyState, RatingStars, StatusBadge, TrustBadge, etc.)
src/components/form/ (TextInput, TextArea, Select, PhoneInput, PriceInput, DatePicker, FileUpload, LocationPicker)
src/context/AppContext.ts (favorites, compare, myListings, recentlyViewed, savedSearches, showToast, etc.)
src/data/mockData.ts (categories, listings, businesses, jobs, conversations, sampleReviews, etc.)
tailwind.config.js (design tokens: colors, spacing, shadows per MARBOU brand)
directory_structure: src/ has: App.tsx (router), context/ (Auth/App/I18n), i18n/ (translations, context), pages/ (all route handlers), components/ (ui.tsx for shared, form/ for inputs, marketplace/ for listing widgets), data/ (mockData.ts), router/ (Router.tsx), utils/ (performance utilities from Phase 1). Public assets in public/. Build output to dist/.
